mapper.select: SELECT * FROM CHALLENGE WHERE DELETE_YN = false ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT * FROM CHALLENGE WHERE CODE = #{code} AND DELETE_YN = false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHALLENGE ( EMP_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, START_DATE, END_DATE, STATUS, CREATED_AT, DELETE_YN ) VALUES ( #{empId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, NOW(), false )
mapper.update: UPDATE CHALLENGE SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, START_DATE = #{startDate}, END_DATE = #{endDate}, STATUS = #{status}, DELETE_YN = #{deleteYn}, UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE CODE = #{code}
mapper.select: SELECT c.CODE, c.EMP_ID, c.TITLE, c.CONTENT, c.START_DATE, c.END_DATE, c.STATUS, c.CREATED_AT, c.UPDATED_AT, c.DELETE_YN, COUNT(ce.MEM_CODE) AS participantCount FROM challenge c LEFT JOIN challenge_entry ce ON c.CODE = ce.CHAL_CODE AND ce.DELETE_YN = false WHERE c.DELETE_YN = false GROUP BY c.CODE, c.EMP_ID, c.TITLE, c.CONTENT, c.START_DATE, c.END_DATE, c.STATUS, c.CREATED_AT, c.UPDATED_AT, c.DELETE_YN ORDER BY participantCount DESC, c.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 3
